d: A dramatic police encounter took place in Asansol, West Bengal, where police arrested fugitive accused Pratap Das after an exchange of fire. According to police, Das had earlier fired two rounds at the police team and escaped when they reached to arrest him. On 27 Nov, police launched another operation in the area and managed to catch him. During the operation, Das allegedly tried to escape and police fired at his leg.
